profile.reading:
The address associated with this record, 1305 Canterbury Drive in Hays, Kansas, belongs to Cloud Storage Corp, a company whose own website describes it not as an operator of data center infrastructure but as a reseller of new and refurbished IT hardware, including memory modules, storage drives, CPUs, and networking equipment, serving customers who maintain their own server and storage environments. The company has operated in this line of business since 2012. Nothing in its public materials describes owned or leased data hall space, critical power capacity, cooling systems, or colocation services of the kind normally associated with a data center operator, and no announcement, permit, or filing describing a facility build was located.

Hays is a small city of roughly 20,000 people in Ellis County, in the high plains of northwest-central Kansas, along Interstate 70 roughly midway between Denver and Kansas City. It is not a recognized data center market. The region's computing infrastructure is dominated by small enterprise server rooms, agricultural and healthcare IT operations, and local telecom facilities rather than wholesale or colocation campuses. A Canterbury Drive address in a city of this size and character is far more consistent with a light-industrial office, showroom, or warehouse space suited to receiving, testing, and reselling hardware components than with a purpose-built data center of any scale.

This entry most likely reflects a name-based match made during data collection: "Cloud Storage Corp" reads, on its face, like a data center or cloud-services operator, but the company's own description of its business points squarely to IT-asset resale and refurbishment rather than facility operation. No permit records, utility filings, or trade-press coverage describing a data center at this address were found, and none would be expected given the nature of the business as the company itself describes it. The record is preserved here rather than removed, consistent with a general policy against deleting registry entries, but readers researching data center capacity in Hays, Kansas, or looking for Cloud Storage Corp as an infrastructure provider should understand that the available public record does not support treating this address as an operating data center. At most, it describes a corporate office or warehouse supporting a hardware resale business, not a facility with servers running on behalf of outside customers.

reading.body:
This facility is not a data center. Cloud Storage Corp describes itself as a reseller of new and refurbished IT hardware components such as memory, storage drives, CPUs, and networking equipment, with no published description of operating physical data center infrastructure. The company's listed address in Hays, Kansas may reflect a warehouse or office rather than a facility designed to host customer workloads.

No power capacity, cooling capacity, or any infrastructure specifications are published for this address. Without published megawatt figures, no calculation of rack density or accelerator count is possible.

Kansas has three mapped data center facilities on record, none with published power capacity in this registry. This entry is flagged as likely misclassified and may not belong in a registry tracking operational AI-relevant data center capacity.
